name: Activate Fleets
text: Have a command token in each of 5 systems that contain your ships.

name: Advanced Technologies
text: Own or control any combination of 5 technologies or technology specialty planets, respectively.

name: Begin The Arms Race
text: Have 3 units with a cost of at least 2 in each of 2 systems.

name: Centralize Research
text: Own 2 technologies of a color and have a structure on a technology specialty planet of that color that is not adjacent to your home system.

name: Command Many Fleets
text: Have 3 non-fighter ships in each of 3 systems.

name: Control the Culture
text: Control planets with more combined influence than each of 2 players that are your neighbors.

name: Coordinate Colonies
text: Control 2 planets outside your home system that are not adjacent to each other.

name: Declare Festival
text: Exhaust 3 planets you control outside of your home system.

name: Defend Research Outposts
text: Have a structure on each of 2 planets you control with different technology specialties.

name: Demonstrate Power
text: Have at least 1 ship with a cost of 3 or more in each of 4 systems.

name: Develop Weaponry
text: Own 2 unit upgrade technologies and have at least 2 of each of those units on the game board.

name: Diversify Interests
text: Have a structure on a planet of each of 3 different traits.

name: Divide Research Efforts
text: Own 2 technologies in each of 2 colors and control at least 1 technology specialty of each of those colors.

name: Engineer a Marvel
text: Have your flagship or war sun in a system that is not in or adjacent to your home system, ignoring wormhole adjacency.

name: Expand Knowledge
text: Own technologies with a combined 5 prerequisites

name: Hold Divergent Interests
text: Control a planet of each trait, a planet with an attachment, and 2 planets with different technology specialties.

name: Hold Key Planets
text: Control 3 planets with at least 4 combined influence and resources.

name: Influential Dominion
text: Control 4 planets with at least 2 influence.

name: Infrastructure Expansion
text: Have 2 structures on the game board that are not in or adjacent to your home system.

name: Infrastructure Specialization
text: Have a structure on 2 different planets of the same trait.

name: Intimidate Distant Worlds
text: Have units in each of 3 systems that are not in or adjacent to your home system.

name: Intimidate the Council
text: Have 1 or more ships in 2 systems that are adjacent to Mecatol Rex.

name: Intimidate Their Home
text: Have at least 6 units in or adjacent to other players' home systems.

name: Intimidate Their Worlds
text: Have ships in 2 systems that contain a planet controlled by another player.

name: Invest in the Future
text: Exhaust 1 planet in each of 3 different systems.

name: Lead on Two Fronts
text: Control 3 planets of a trait and 2 planets of another trait.

name: Mobilize Forces
text: Have more non-fighter, non-infantry units in or adjacent to the Mecatol Rex system than each of 2 of your neighbors.

name: Mobilize Strike Forces
text: Have 3 non-fighter, non-infantry units of the same type in each of 4 systems.

name: Patrol Disputed Territory
text: Have ships in each of 5 systems that are in systems adjacent to other players' units or planets.

name: Power Cities
text: Exhaust 3 planets that contain your structures.

name: Probe The Fracture
text:
*When you reveal this objective, put The Fracture in play.*

Have a unit in each of 3 systems in The Fracture or with an ingress token.

name: Raise an Army
text: Have 15 non-infantry, non-fighter units on the game board.

name: Resourceful Holdings
text: Control 3 planets with at least 3 resources.

name: Seize the Wealth
text: Control planets with more combined resources than each of 2 players that are your neighbors.

name: Specialize Armies
text: Have none of a unit type in your reinforcements while owning that unit's upgrade technology.

name: Specialize Designs
text: Control a technology specialty planet matching each prerequisite for a unit upgrade technology you own.

name: Spread the Sphere
text: Control at least 1 planet in each of 4 non-home systems.

name: Spread Vessels of War
text: Have a ship with a cost of at least 3 in each of 4 systems.

name: Steer Market Forces
text: Spend 10 influence, resources, or a mix thereof.

name: Strategic Exhaustion
text: Exhaust 2 planets outside your home system each with at least a combined 4 influence and resources.

name: Strategic Presence
text: Have a ship in each of 4 systems that contain or are adjacent to another player's home system, Mecatol Rex, or a legendary planet.

name: Strengthen Claim
text: Control 4 planets that are legendary, Mecatol Rex, in other players home systems, or adjacent to any of the aforementioned planet types.

name: Study Beyond Spacetime
text: Have a unit in each of 3 systems that contain or are adjacent to a wormhole, gravity rift, or entropic scar.

name: Technological Triumph
text: Own 2 technologies of a color, a technology specialty planet of that color, and a unit upgrade with a prerequisite of that color.

name: Unify Distant Lands
text: Control 2 planets with the same trait that are not in or adjacent to your home system.

name: Unit Specialization
text: Have none of 3 different unit types in your reinforcements.

name: Activate Armada
text: Have a command token in each of 8 systems that contain your ships.

name: Advanced Infrastructure
text: Have a structure on 4 different planets of the same trait.

name: Annex Their Worlds
text: Control 4 planets with the same trait that are not in or adjacent to your home system.

name: Assert Military Dominance
text: Have 25 non-infantry, non-fighter units on the game board.

name: Become a Master of Ships
text: Have 3 non-fighter ships in each of 5 systems.

name: Bend Their Will
text: Control planets in or adjacent to other players' home systems with a combine influence value of at least 5.

name: Brave Two Frontiers
text: Control 4 planets of each of 2 different traits.

name: Claim Supremacy
text: Control 7 planets that are legendary, Mecatol Rex, in other players home systems, or adjacent to any of the aforementioned planet types.

name: Closely Monitor Rivals
text: Have at least 8 units in or adjacent to each of 2 different other players' home systems.

name: Control Distant Outposts
text: Have 3 structures on the game board that are not in or adjacent to your home system.

name: Coordinate an Empire
text: Control 4 planets outside your home system that are not adjacent to each other.

name: Defend Diverse Interests
text: Have 2 structures on planets of each of 3 different traits.

name: Defy Physical Limits
text: Have a unit in each of 6 systems that contain or are adjacent to a wormhole, gravity rift, or entropic scar.

name: Dominant Fleet Presence
text: Have a ship in each of 7 systems that contain or are adjacent to another player's home system, Mecatol Rex, or a legendary planet.

name: Dominate Divergent Worlds
text: Control 2 planets of each trait, 2 planets with an attachment, and 3 planets with different a technology specialties.

name: Dominate Foreign Space
text: Have units in each of 5 systems that are not in or adjacent your home system.

name: Dominate Great Worlds
text: Exhaust 3 planets outside your home system each with at least a combined 4 influence and resources.

name: Dominate Specializations
text: Own 4 technologies in each of 2 colors and control at least 1 technology specialty of each of those colors.

name: Dominate the Seat of Power
text: Have 10 non-fighter, non-infantry units in or adjacent to the Mecatol Rex system.

name: Dominate the Sphere
text: Control at least 1 planet in each of 6 non-home systems.

name: Elegant Engineering
text: Have at least 1 shps with a cost of 3 or more in each of 6 systems.

name: Galactic Celebrations
text: Exhaust 5 planets you control outside of your home system.

name: Influential Empire
text: Control 5 planets with at least 3 influence.

name: Invest in an Empire
text: Exhaust 1 planet in each of 5 different systems.

name: Lead The Arms Race
text: Have 3 units with a cost of at least 2 in each of 4 systems.

name: Mandate Imperial Research
text: Own 2 technologies of 2 colors and have a structure on technology specialty planets of those colors that is not adjacent to your home system.

name: Master Technologist
text: Own 4 technologies of a color, 2 technology specialty planets of that color, and a unit upgrade with a prerequisite of that color.

name: Master the Design Space
text: Control a technology specialty planet matching each prerequisite for 2 unit upgrade technologies you own.

name: Mobilize Assault Squads
text: Have 3 non-fighter, non-infantry units of the same type in each of 6 systems.

name: Monopolize Research
text: Have a structure on each of 3 planets you control with different technology specialties.

name: Power an Empire
text: Exhaust 5 planets that contain your structures.

name: Proliferate Warships
text: Have a ship with a cost of at least 3 in each of 7 systems.

name: Push Design Boundaries
text: Have none of each of 2 unit types in your reinforcements while owning those units' upgrade technologies.

name: Research Mastery
text: Own or control any combination of 10 technologies or technology specialty planets, respectively.

name: Resource Dominion
text: Control 5 planets with at least 3 resources.

name: Revolutionize Warfare
text: Own 3 unit upgrade technologies and have at least 2 of each of those units on the game board.

name: Shatter Frontiers
text: Own technologies with a combined 10 prerequisites.

name: Shatter Markets
text: Spend 20 influence, resources, or a mix thereof.

name: Subdue the Galaxy
text: Control 10 planets in non-home systems.

name: Subdue the Fracture
text:
*When you reveal this objective, put The Fracture in play.*

Have a unit in each of 5 systems in The Fracture or with an ingress token.

name: Subjugate Critical Planets
text: Control 4 planets with at least 5 combined influence and resources.

name: Terrorize The Skies
text: Have ships in 4 systems that contain a planet controlled by another player.

name: Unit Mastery
text: Have none of 5 different unit types in your reinforcements.

name: Usurp Disputed Space
text: Have ships in each of 9 systems that are in systems adjacent to other players' units or planets.

name: Usurp Their Resources
text: Control planets in or adjacent to other players home systems with a combine resource value of at least 5.
